library(dplyr)

# Defining Functions

### Functions to fit different types of curves

```{r}
#log transformed linear model
fit_log <- function(df, residual_col, intensity_col) {
  
  residual <- df[[residual_col]]
  intensity <- df[[intensity_col]]
  
  #fit the model
  model <- tryCatch(
    lm(residual ~ log(intensity)), 
    error = function(e) {
      message("Model fitting failed: ", e$message)
    })
  
  return(model)
}

#linear model
fit_line <- function(df, residual_col, intensity_col) {
  
  residual <- df[[residual_col]]
  intensity <- df[[intensity_col]]
  
  #fit the model
  model <- tryCatch(
    lm(residual ~ intensity), 
    error = function(e) {
      message("Model fitting failed: ", e$message)
    })
  
  return(model)
}

#polynomial function
fit_poly <- function(df, residual_col, intensity_col) {
  
  residual <- df[[residual_col]]
  intensity <- df[[intensity_col]]
  
  #fit the model
  model <- tryCatch(
    lm(residual ~ poly(intensity, 2)),
    error = function(e) {
      message("Model fitting failed: ", e$message)
    })
  
  return(model)
}

```

### Functions to make predictions

```{r}
#function to predict values using the fitted model
exp_predict <- function(df, new_df, model_type = c("exp", "pwr", "decay", "log", "line", "ploy"), residual_col, intensity_col) {
  
  #fit the correct model
  if(model_type == "exp") {
    model <- fit_exponential(df, residual_col, intensity_col)
  } 
  if(model_type == "pwr") {
    model <- fit_power_law(df, residual_col, intensity_col)
  } 
  if(model_type == "decay") {
    model <- fit_decay(df, residual_col, intensity_col)
  }
  if(model_type == "log") {
    model <- fit_log(df, residual_col, intensity_col)
  }
  if(model_type == "line") {
    model <- fit_line(df, residual_col, intensity_col)
  }
  if(model_type == "poly") {
    model <- fit_poly(df, residual_col, intensity_col)
  }
  
  #if model fits, generate predictions df
  if (!is.null(model)) {
    pred_df <- data.frame(
      intensity = new_df$intensity,
      predicted = predict(model, newdata = new_df),
      rse = summary(model)$sigma
    )
    return(pred_df)
  } else {
    failed_df <- new_df %>%
      mutate(group = NA) %>% 
      mutate(predicted = NA) %>% 
      mutate(rese = NA)
    
    return(failed_df)
  }
}
```

# Reading in Data and cleaning

```{r}
h3_matern_timed <- read.csv("data/H3_matern_timed.csv")
h3_poisson_timed <- read.csv("data/H3_poisson_timed.csv") %>% 
  filter(Number.of.clumps == 5, Poisson.mean == 3)
h3_random_timed <- read.csv("data/H3_random_timed.csv")

#create new data for predictions
new_dat <- data.frame(intensity = c(seq(0, 30, length.out = 100)))
```

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#clean_names
timed_clean <- rbind(h3_matern_timed, h3_poisson_timed, h3_random_timed) %>% 
  janitor::clean_names() %>% 
  mutate(spatial_distribution = case_when(spatial_distribution == "Clumped-Matern" ~ paste(matern_clump_placement), T ~ spatial_distribution)) %>% 
  filter(detectability_of_rare_mussels == 0.3)

#calculate prop found
timed_proportion_found <- timed_clean %>% 
  mutate(proportion_found = total_mussels_detected/total_mussels) %>% 
  mutate(m_sampled = sum_of_quadrats_per_surveyor/4) %>% 
  mutate(person_hours_searched = round(person_hours_searched, 1)) %>% 
  mutate(density_cat = case_when(true_mussel_density %in% c(0.1, 0.01) ~ "rare", T ~ "common"))
```

# Running Models 

```{r}
#log
timed_log_model_preds <- timed_proportion_found %>%
  group_by(spatial_distribution, density_cat) %>%
  group_modify( ~ exp_predict(.x, new_df = new_dat, model_type = "log", 
                              residual = "proportion_found", 
                              intensity = "person_hours_searched"))

#poly
timed_poly_model_preds <- timed_proportion_found %>%
  group_by(spatial_distribution, density_cat) %>%
  group_modify( ~ exp_predict(.x, new_df = new_dat, model_type = "poly", 
                              residual = "proportion_found", 
                              intensity = "person_hours_searched"))

#linear
timed_line_model_preds <- timed_proportion_found %>%
  group_by(spatial_distribution, density_cat) %>%
  group_modify( ~ exp_predict(.x, new_df = new_dat, model_type = "line", 
                              residual = "proportion_found", 
                              intensity = "person_hours_searched"))
```

# Table of RSEs

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#bind RSE into table
timed_rse_table <- data.frame(
  spatial_distribution = c(timed_line_model_preds$spatial_distribution),
  density = c(timed_line_model_preds$density_cat),
  log_rse= c(timed_log_model_preds$rse),
  poly_rse = c(timed_poly_model_preds$rse),
  line_rse = c(timed_line_model_preds$rse)) %>% 
  distinct()

#add colum which has min rse model name
y <- colnames(timed_rse_table)[apply(timed_rse_table[,c(3:5)],1,which.min) + 2]
timed_rse_table$min_col <- y

knitr::kable(timed_rse_table) %>% 
  kable_styling()
```

# Figure of best models

```{r}
#bind predictions into table
timed_best_fit_preds <- rbind(
  timed_log_model_preds,
  timed_poly_model_preds,
  timed_line_model_preds
) %>% 
  group_by(spatial_distribution, density_cat, intensity) %>% 
  slice_min(order_by = rse, n = 1, with_ties = T)

#plot the data and fitted curves
timed_prop <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = timed_best_fit_preds, aes(x = intensity, y = predicted,
                                           linetype = density_cat,
                                           color = spatial_distribution),
            linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Timed Search",
       x = "Person Hours Searched",
       y = "Proportion Found") +
   scale_color_manual(name = "Mussel Spatial Distribution",
                     values = c("random" = "#CC79A7", 
                                "Clumped-Poisson" = "#D55E00",
                                "One shore only" = "#E69F00",
                                "One shore; one middle" = "#56B4E9",
                                "One shore; one middle; 2 additional" = "#009E73",
                                "One shore; 2 additional" = "#F0E442",
                                "Randomly placed" = "#0072B2"),
                     labels = c("random" = "Random", 
                                "Clumped-Poisson" = "Poisson",
                                "One shore only" = "Clumped Matern 1S",
                                "One shore; one middle" = "Clumped Matern 1S+1M",
                                "One shore; one middle; 2 additional" = "Clumped Matern 1S+1M+2",
                                "One shore; 2 additional" = "Clumped Matern 1S+2", 
                                "Randomly placed" = "Clumped Matern 3"),
                     limits = c("random", 
                                "Clumped-Poisson", 
                                "One shore only", 
                                "One shore; one middle", 
                                "One shore; one middle; 2 additional", 
                                "One shore; 2 additional", 
                                "Randomly placed")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(name = expression(
    paste("True Mussel Density")),
    values = c("rare" = "dashed", "common" = "solid")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5))

timed_prop

ggsave("figures/H3_timed_proportion_time.png", plot = timed_prop, width = 12, height = 8)
```
